title: EFT_Operator_Scan: an effective-operator scan and sensitivity-mapping code for photon-dark matter elastic scattering
description: Analysis code accompanying "Photon-Dark Matter Elastic Scattering: An Effective-Operator Scan and First Limits from the Galactic Halo" (Stenhouse et al., submitted to Phys. Rev. D). Computes gamma-chi elastic-scattering optical depths for a dimension 5-7 dipole/Rayleigh effective-operator basis and its UV completions, builds chi-squared and f_required sensitivity maps against Fermi-LAT gamma-ray spectra, and generates the paper's figures. The digitised 90% CL exclusion grids needed to reproduce the figures are included; the pixel-level MCMC Galactic-centre halo posterior that is the primary physical input is released separately with the companion paper's own Zenodo archive.
notes: Once the primary paper has an arXiv identifier, add it to related_identifiers as {"identifier": "arXiv:NNNN.NNNNN", "relation": "isSupplementTo", "resource_type": "publication-article", "scheme": "arxiv"}.
